prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Regional Dispatch Center (Juniper): authorized intake/triage/dispatch; verifies authorization/currency/priority; immediate highest-available threat dispatch; produces Unit Staging Change Card; uses Battery Swap Voucher, queue snapshot, Caller Location Correction Slip; retains controlled audit evidence; records restriction rationale/scope/duration; reviews thresholded service measures. Shift Commander (Sundial): readiness/surge/continuity; receives Coverage Gap Bulletin; sends Mutual Aid Release Form; may restrict unsafe defective capabilities; cannot override clinical/crew judgment; authority until acknowledged succession. Regional Medical Director: clinical guidance/change approval, not dispatch; jointly reviews significant events with commander. Call Taker Mara (Larkspur): verifies caller/location/clinical/hazard/access details; produces correction slip; receives Bedside Arrival Receipt; maintains caller connection. Triage Supervisor (Copperfield): reassessment/priority, risk/escalation reviews, surge/override validation; sends Pediatric Acuity Note; reviews audit memo before duplicate closure. Concerning pediatric findings require prompt escalation. Computer Aided Dispatch Console: confirmed status/time/source; approved-scenario testing before authorization. Ambulance Coordination Platform: position/status/coverage/matching/destinations; separates accepted mutual aid; queues interrupted updates for reconciliation; pre-release operational/clinical/security/continuity assessment; availability/latency/integrity/interface monitoring. North Gate Status Board and South Gate Status Board: separate access/reach/movement views; latter produces South Access Lane Notice. Radio Coordinator (Mistral): reachability/backups/faults; sends bulletin below threshold; uses change card and lane notice. Regional Radio Network: outage/restoration announcements; post-maintenance/configuration checks before normal use. Failed voice requires available approved-data fallback, timestamped attempts, retry/supervisor alert for missing acknowledgments; reconcile delayed reports, retain discrepancies. Data Quality Officer: completeness/timestamps/outcomes; reviews Pebble (unidentified) conflicts. Ambulance Unit 417: restored-contact position/safety report. Fleet Maintenance Cell: radio-fault escalation; uses release form; guided preventive maintenance; asset/work/parts/return-to-service records. Hospital Liaison Desk: telephone acceptance, minimized review observations. Emergency Department staff: backup arrivals. Paramedic Crew: local safety; no uncertain entry. Audits document records/criteria/limitations. Findings require owner/deadline/closure-verification; releases require owner/tests/limitations/rollback. Reviews cover demand/coverage/delay/communications/data-quality; verify corrective effectiveness, investigate systemic recurrence, incorporate
